description: Saya MMD motion manifest. Descriptions describe how motions look; local semantic routing maps conversation context to intent/category, then selects concrete VMD files.
notes: Do not treat description/source_name/comment as trigger text. They are human-facing annotations only.
Loop motions are used for idle, listening, waiting, and processing states. Reaction motions play once and return to idle.
Robot_idle_418.vmd is intentionally not listed. The easter_egg logic remains and now uses Fairy/playful actions.

motions.description: 更好的平常站着。主待机循环，也可作为回答时的稳定动作。
motions.comment: Current English file name: Idle_normal_187.vmd.

motions.description: 向左右边看看。自然待机与轻度关注。
motions.comment: Current English file name: Idle4_157.vmd.

motions.description: 只是平常站着。普通小概率待机循环。
motions.comment: Current English file name: a_idle_neutral_loop_88.vmd.

motions.description: 左顾右盼。适合聆听、观察、情绪问题。
motions.comment: Current English file name: Idle_341.vmd.

motions.description: 手放在裙子上倾听。适合情绪倾听和安慰。
motions.comment: Current English file name: lifegurad_idle_272.vmd.

motions.description: 叉腰叹气。适合低落、等待、轻微埋怨。
motions.comment: Current English file name: wainting_359.vmd.

motions.description: 向下查看。任务处理、查询、思考时循环。
motions.comment: Current English file name: Idle_searchong_173.vmd.

motions.description: 给出回答时的自信动作。
motions.comment: Current English file name: Idle_motion_confident_148.vmd.

motions.description: 向电脑外张望。适合心情好、好奇、轻松互动。
motions.comment: Current English file name: looking_96.vmd.

motions.description: 升起来吓你一下。虽然文件名含 idle，但动作语义是彩蛋/惊吓式反应，更适合播放一次后回到待机。
motions.comment: Current English file name: Fairy_idle_362.vmd.

motions.description: 伸手/牵手式回应。适合被夸赞或温柔安抚时播放一次，不作为常驻待机。
motions.comment: Current English file name: hold_hands_119.vmd.

motions.description: 打哈欠。夜间或困倦时循环。
motions.comment: Current English file name: Sleepy_yawn_idle_113.vmd.

motions.description: 困死了被惊醒。语义是被打断后的反应，不适合作为普通夜间循环。
motions.comment: Current English file name: Sleepy_idle_158.vmd.

motions.description: 拜拜。适合告别、下次见。
motions.comment: Original Chinese annotation: 拜拜. Current English file name: farewell_wave.vmd.

motions.description: 不行。明确拒绝、不要这样。
motions.comment: Original Chinese annotation: 不行. Current English file name: refusal_no.vmd.

motions.description: 不行_2。拒绝动作的变化版。
motions.comment: Original Chinese annotation: 不行_2. Current English file name: refusal_no_alt.vmd.

motions.description: 朝你开枪（耍可爱）。玩笑、调皮、彩蛋。
motions.comment: Original Chinese annotation: 朝你开枪（耍可爱）. Current English file name: playful_finger_gun.vmd.

motions.description: 吃醋了。适合吃醋、占有欲玩笑。
motions.comment: Original Chinese annotation: 吃醋了. Current English file name: jealous_pout.vmd.

motions.description: 吃惊。轻度惊讶。
motions.comment: Original Chinese annotation: 吃惊. Current English file name: surprised_small.vmd.

motions.description: 大胆偷笑。玩笑、坏笑、轻松互动。
motions.comment: Original Chinese annotation: 大胆偷笑. Current English file name: bold_snicker.vmd.

motions.description: 大声打招呼。适合见面、回来、呼唤。
motions.comment: Original Chinese annotation: 大声打招呼. Current English file name: loud_greeting.vmd.

motions.description: 道歉。仅用于 Saya 的回复语义确实是在道歉、承认说错或被要求道歉，不用于用户道歉时。
motions.comment: Original Chinese annotation: 道歉. Current English file name: apologizing.vmd.

motions.description: 福尔摩斯思考。适合推理/分析期间维持思考状态，可循环。
motions.comment: Original Chinese annotation: 福尔摩斯思考. Current English file name: detective_thinking.vmd.

motions.description: 感到惊喜。开心的惊讶。
motions.comment: Original Chinese annotation: 感到惊喜. Current English file name: delighted_surprise.vmd.

motions.description: 哈哈大笑。明显开心或觉得好笑。
motions.comment: Original Chinese annotation: 哈哈大笑. Current English file name: hearty_laugh.vmd.

motions.description: 害羞脸红。被表白、夸赞或亲密表达时。
motions.comment: Original Chinese annotation: 害羞脸红. Current English file name: shy_blush.vmd.

motions.description: 很吃惊。强烈惊讶。
motions.comment: Original Chinese annotation: 很吃惊. Current English file name: surprised_big.vmd.

motions.description: 困惑挠头右。疑惑、不懂、思考卡住。
motions.comment: Original Chinese annotation: 困惑挠头右. Current English file name: confused_head_scratch_right.vmd.

motions.description: 困惑挠头左。疑惑、不懂、思考卡住。
motions.comment: Original Chinese annotation: 困惑挠头左. Current English file name: confused_head_scratch_left.vmd.

motions.description: 困了。更像困倦表达/过渡反应，播放一次后回到夜间待机。
motions.comment: Original Chinese annotation: 困了. Current English file name: sleepy_tired.vmd.

motions.description: 困了闭眼。适合夜间或困倦状态下维持循环。
motions.comment: Original Chinese annotation: 困了闭眼. Current English file name: sleepy_eyes_closed.vmd.

motions.description: 没关系啊。仅用于用户道歉、自责或请求原谅时，Saya 做安抚/原谅回应；不等同于 Saya 道歉。
motions.comment: Original Chinese annotation: 没关系啊. Current English file name: reassuring_nevermind.vmd.

motions.description: 挠脸（困惑）。轻微困惑或不好意思。
motions.comment: Original Chinese annotation: 挠脸（困惑）. Current English file name: confused_cheek_scratch.vmd.

motions.description: 你是在找茬吗。玩笑式挑衅或吐槽。
motions.comment: Original Chinese annotation: 你是在找茬吗. Current English file name: teasing_are_you_picking_a_fight.vmd.

motions.description: 敲门。呼唤、打招呼、提醒注意；可作为 greeting 的变化。
motions.comment: Original Chinese annotation: 敲门. Current English file name: door_knock.vmd.

motions.description: 撒娇（你坏坏）。亲密玩笑、撒娇。
motions.comment: Original Chinese annotation: 撒娇（你坏坏）. Current English file name: coquettish_you_are_bad.vmd.

motions.description: 伸出左手（邀请）。牵手、邀请、靠近。
motions.comment: Original Chinese annotation: 伸出左手（邀请）. Current English file name: inviting_left_hand.vmd.

motions.description: 双臂插胸前。姿态型等待/不满动作，适合短时间循环维持情绪。
motions.comment: Original Chinese annotation: 双臂插胸前. Current English file name: arms_crossed_front.vmd.

motions.description: 思考。普通思考/处理中动作，适合循环。
motions.comment: Original Chinese annotation: 思考. Current English file name: thinking.vmd.

motions.description: 头扭到一边（哼）。撒娇式不满/委屈；也可作为吃醋语义的低概率变化。
motions.comment: Original Chinese annotation: 头扭到一边（哼）. Current English file name: pout_turn_head_hmph.vmd.

motions.description: 无奈看着你（听你说）。是持续倾听/陪伴姿态，适合作为情绪聆听循环。
motions.comment: Original Chinese annotation: 无奈看着你（听你说）. Current English file name: helpless_listening_look.vmd.

motions.description: 小心地笑。轻柔开心、安抚、缓和气氛；用于夸赞/安慰的轻量变化。
motions.comment: Original Chinese annotation: 小心地笑. Current English file name: cautious_smile.vmd.

motions.description: 有办法了。想到方案或准备给答案。
motions.comment: Original Chinese annotation: 有办法了. Current English file name: got_an_idea.vmd.

motions.description: 有办法了_2。想到方案的变化版。
motions.comment: Original Chinese annotation: 有办法了_2. Current English file name: got_an_idea_alt.vmd.

motions.description: 有点害怕的敲门。害怕、小心试探。
motions.comment: Original Chinese annotation: 有点害怕的敲门. Current English file name: timid_door_knock.vmd.

motions.description: 指向自己（我吗？）。疑问是不是自己、被点名。
motions.comment: Original Chinese annotation: 指向自己（我吗？）. Current English file name: pointing_to_self_me.vmd.

motions.description: 左手挠头（困扰）。困扰、纠结、麻烦。
motions.comment: Original Chinese annotation: 左手挠头（困扰）. Current English file name: troubled_left_head_scratch.vmd.
